```lean
theorem lg_target (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : StrictMono f) (n : ℕ) : n ≤ f n := by
  induction n
  · exact le_refl 0
  · let d := n - 1
    let hd := ih
    have h1 : d ≤ f d := hd
    have h2 : f d < f (d + 1) := hf d (d + 1)
    have h3 : d + 1 ≤ f (d + 1) :=
      le_of_lt_add_one (lt_trans h1 h2)
    exact h3
```
